Ogun State is set for a spectacular celebration of faith, music and the Christmas spirit as the 2026 State Christmas Carol takes centre stage on Thursday, 17 December with the General Overseer of the Redeemed Christian Church of God ( RCCG ), Pastor Enoch Adeboye, among the leading ministers expected to grace the occasion.
A statement on Wednesday by Kayode Akinmade, Special Adviser to Governor Dapo Abiodun on Information and Strategy, said the grand celebration, scheduled for the Arcade Ground, Oke-Mosan, Abeokuta, at 5:00 p.m., promises an evening of inspiring ministrations, soul-lifting gospel music and thanksgiving.
Adeboye will minister alongside other prominent men of God, while an impressive line-up of gospel artistes, including Ayon Jesu, Alaseyori, BJ Sax, Laolu Gbenjo, Vintage and the Loud Choir, will lead the musical celebration.
Adding colour and grandeur to the occasion will be performances by mass choirs, including the Ogun State Choir, Olabisi Onabanjo University (OOU) Choir and the Regional Choir.
The annual Christmas Carol, which brings together Christians and residents from different walks of life, provides an opportunity for spiritual reflection, thanksgiving and celebration of the birth of Jesus Christ.
The event is expected to attract worshippers, gospel music lovers and members of the public from across Ogun State and beyond.
Residents are invited to be part of the celebration, which promises an unforgettable evening of worship, praise and Christmas fellowship.
